cc:Work.dc:description: QoE tasks count all inputs, including sessions outside the selected area. (a) One full audit versus two full baseline recomputations, excluding signing, chain waits and decryption. (b) After auditing and bisection, two certifiers per method: one disputed instruction (upper) or the full program (lower). CPU separates FHE processes from task checks/signing, including overhead but excluding context certification, operator work and full auditing. Means with sample SD from 30 pairs in (a) and five cases in (b).
